title: Drunk Man Gets Himself Arrested for the 15th Time
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On March 24, 2023, officers were called to a domestic disturbance in La Crosse, WI. Dispatch informed them of an intoxicated male involved in altercations with his girlfriend. The individual has a significant criminal history and tends to undergo an extreme personality shift when under the influence of alcohol. Eventually, officers found him as a passenger in a vehicle and instructed him to exit, but he resisted and was uncooperative. According to online records, he’s been arrested 14 times since 2019.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
